newsitem.title: EGYPT: Plane lands in Cairo, lets off sick Briton.
newsitem.headline: Plane lands in Cairo, lets off sick Briton.

text.p: A British Airways plane made an unscheduled landing at Cairo airport on Monday to let off for treatment a British man who suffered a heart attack mid-flight, airport sources said.
They said the man, named as Michael John, became ill while the plane was en route from London to Nairobi.

The pilot asked for permission to land as soon as he entered Egyptian airspace and airport officials rushed John to a nearby Cairo hospital, the sources added. The plane then resumed its flight to Nairobi.
